blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —President Marcos is being pressed by Senator Risa Hontiveros and nine other House lawmakers to expel Chinese Ambassador Jing Quan, saying his warning that China could “easily win” a confrontation with the Philippines had made him unwelcome. This call was made as Senator Robinhood Padilla praised the Chinese envoy as a “gentleman” after meeting him. Hontiveros filed Senate Resolution No. 746 urging Marcos to declare Jing persona non grata or ask Beijing to recall him. The move put Hontiveros at odds with Marcos, who has opted against expelling the envoy in favor of diplomatic engagement, even as nine House […]...
